layout.clip: <collection>/<id>.mp4 with synced AAC audio embedded (loader reads audio from the video)
layout.caption: <collection>/<id>.txt next to each clip
layout.splits: train.jsonl / val.jsonl / test.jsonl (fields: id, collection, video_file, audio_file, caption, source_id)

media.video: H.264 CRF20, height capped at 720, no upscaling
media.audio: mono, 48 kHz delivered (loader resamples; mono duplication to stereo is permitted, keep provenance)

splits.grouping: all clips from one source_id stay in one split

benchmark.audio: must be enabled; nonzero audio loss mask required

flags.caption_method: faster-whisper large-v3-turbo, Kannada forced; automatic, not human verified
